name: Harness reads the percentage bonus of a combat rating of a Witch Doctor
contract: ADR 1048 (provisional) adds combat_rating_bonus, Player::GetRatingBonusValue of one CombatRating. The fixture
gives 280 ranged critical strike rating (CR_CRIT_RANGED 9) and none of spell critical strike rating
(CR_CRIT_SPELL 10). At level 60 the DBC rating tables give 14.0 rating per point (gtCombatRatings row 959)
and a Witch Doctor scalar of 1.0 (gtOCTClassCombatRatingScalar row 394), so the ranged bonus is 20 points
and the spell bonus 0; combat_rating reads the raw 280.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
SETUP: the fixture rating is applied
CONTRACT: 280 ranged critical strike rating is 20 points
CONTROL: no spell critical strike rating, no bonus
